verdict.rationale: Push provisioning into Apple Pay and Google Pay is a fair question for a card-issuing platform like Lithic, so the axis applies. The pack documents no push-provisioning API, entitlements process, in-wallet card art, or manual provisioning fallback. The only wallet-related item is an Auth Rules event stream for deciding on digital wallet tokenization, which is an adjacent control, not provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, cards land in Apple Pay and Google Pay — push provisioning from my app with the entitlements process documented, plus in-wallet card art and manual provisioning as a fallback
